synopsis: Office worker Charrion Zacarias suddenly transmigrates into a world of magic only to inherit a dying boy's staggering debt of billions! As if that weren't bad enough, the boy's failed attempt to summon the Dark God leaves Charrion bound by a soul contract which is to fulfill the Dark God's 999 wishes or face complete annihilation. His only hope is that mysterious talking notebook known as God's Notebook. A modern-day salaryman take on a ruthless, power-driven world, using workplace savvy, relentless hustle, and relentless training to defy fate. The servant of the Dark God refuses to give up! synopsis: At 34 years old, Kubo Tamotsu works at an exploitative company only to wake up one day in an unfamiliar world, reincarnated into the body of a six-year-old. Not aware of his innate “Barrier Master” skills, he finds himself on the slave market, and up for auction! When no one bids on him and he’s queued for disposal, he is rescued in the nick of time by Marquess Basam. He will be raised as the Marquess’ personal Barrier Master under a new name, “Linus,” and his talent as a Barrier Master will grow day by day. His troubles never seem to end, as he struggles to survive! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Shinozaki-kun no Mente Jijou
titleNative: 篠崎くんのメンテ事情
synopsis: Shinozaki – an utterly ordinary salaryman who has been suffering from a "pain in the neck" – finds his otherwise-typical life suddenly interrupted by a young woman named Yuuyake. According to Yuuyake, her magician grandmother had modified Shinozaki’s body to an extreme degree such that he’s chock-full of machinery inside! …All of which require regular maintenance that Yuuyake will apparently be performing from now on. With that, the slightly offbeat daily life begins, between Shinozaki the salaryman, Yuuyake the magician, and a mysterious creature named Grey! (Source: Pixiv Comics, translated) Note: Chapter count includes 43 main chapters, one epilogue, and 14 other extra and bonus chapters.
